faraway.en: A faraway mountain appeared faintly beyond the morning clouds.
faraway.zh: 一座遙遠的山隱約出現在晨間雲層後方。

fifteen.en: Fifteen students submitted their projects before the deadline.
fifteen.zh: 十五名學生在截止時間前繳交了專題。

fifth.en: Our classroom is on the fifth floor of the building.
fifth.zh: 我們的教室位在這棟建築的五樓。

fifty.en: Nearly fifty people attended the public lecture that evening.
fifty.zh: 那天晚上將近五十人參加公開講座。

five.en: Five teams advanced to the final round of the competition.
five.zh: 五支隊伍晉級競賽的最後一輪。

forehead.en: He touched his forehead while trying to remember the answer.
forehead.zh: 他試著回想答案時摸了摸額頭。

forgetful.en: The forgetful student started using reminders for important deadlines.
forgetful.zh: 那位健忘的學生開始用提醒功能記住重要期限。

forty.en: The bus ride took about forty minutes in light traffic.
forty.zh: 交通順暢時，公車車程大約四十分鐘。

four.en: Four volunteers helped organize the books after the event.
four.zh: 活動後有四名志工協助整理書籍。

fourteen.en: Fourteen students joined the optional science tour this semester.
fourteen.zh: 這學期有十四名學生參加選擇性的科學參訪。

humbly.en: She humbly thanked the team for supporting her presentation.
humbly.zh: 她謙虛地感謝團隊支持她的簡報。

humiliation.en: Public humiliation is not an appropriate way to correct mistakes.
humiliation.zh: 公開羞辱並不是糾正錯誤的適當方式。

humorously.en: The speaker humorously described a small mistake from his first job.
humorously.zh: 講者幽默地描述自己第一份工作時的一個小錯誤。

hymn.en: The choir performed a traditional hymn during the cultural program.
hymn.zh: 合唱團在文化活動中演唱了一首傳統聖歌。

hyphen.en: Use a hyphen when the style guide requires one.
hyphen.zh: 如果格式指南要求，就使用連字號。

gaiety.en: Music and bright decorations added gaiety to the town festival.
gaiety.zh: 音樂與鮮豔裝飾為小鎮慶典增添歡樂氣氛。

generalize.en: We should not generalize from one example to every situation.
generalize.zh: 我們不應從單一例子概括到所有情況。

glassware.en: The laboratory stores clean glassware in a locked cabinet.
glassware.zh: 實驗室把乾淨的玻璃器皿存放在櫃子裡。

goldfish.en: A goldfish swam slowly around the plants in the tank.
goldfish.zh: 一隻金魚在魚缸植物周圍緩慢游動。

goodness.en: The story celebrates everyday goodness shown through small acts of kindness.
goodness.zh: 故事歌頌透過小小善行展現的日常善意。

grandchild.en: Each grandchild received a handwritten card from their grandmother.
grandchild.zh: 每位孫子女都收到祖母親手寫的卡片。

granddaughter.en: The granddaughter helped organize old family photographs into albums.
granddaughter.zh: 孫女協助把老家庭照片整理成相簿。

grandson.en: Her grandson visits the library with her every Saturday.
grandson.zh: 她的孫子每週六都陪她去圖書館。

grate.en: Please grate the cheese only if the recipe calls for it.
grate.zh: 只有食譜需要時才把起司磨碎。

gravestone.en: The old gravestone carried a name and a simple date.
gravestone.zh: 那塊老墓碑上刻著一個名字和簡單日期。

graveyard.en: The historic graveyard stands beside a small stone church.
graveyard.zh: 這座歷史悠久的墓園位在一座小石教堂旁。

greatness.en: The biography questions how people define greatness in public life.
greatness.zh: 這本傳記探討人們如何定義公共生活中的偉大。

grove.en: The class rested in a shaded grove during the field trip.
grove.zh: 校外教學時，班上在一片有樹蔭的小樹林休息。

handbook.en: The student handbook explains attendance rules and campus services.
handbook.zh: 學生手冊說明出席規定與校園服務。

happening.en: Several interesting events are happening around campus this week.
happening.zh: 本週校園內正有幾項有趣活動進行。

happiness.en: The survey asked students what activities contributed to their happiness.
happiness.zh: 調查詢問學生哪些活動能提升他們的幸福感。

hardy.en: These hardy plants can survive cold winters with little protection.
hardy.zh: 這些耐寒植物不需太多保護也能度過寒冬。

hare.en: A hare crossed the path and disappeared into the grass.
hare.zh: 一隻野兔穿過小徑後消失在草叢裡。

harshly.en: The reviewer criticized the first draft too harshly.
harshly.zh: 評論者對初稿的批評過於嚴厲。

hastily.en: He hastily packed his notes before leaving the classroom.
hastily.zh: 他離開教室前匆忙收好筆記。

heading.en: Each section has a clear heading above the main text.
heading.zh: 每個段落的正文上方都有清楚的標題。

hearsay.en: The report distinguishes verified evidence from rumor and hearsay.
hearsay.zh: 報告區分已查證證據、謠言與傳聞。

heavier.en: The second box was heavier than the first one.
heavier.zh: 第二個箱子比第一個更重。

heavyweight.en: The article describes the company as a heavyweight in the technology industry.
heavyweight.zh: 文章把這家公司形容為科技業的重要重量級企業。

heiress.en: The novel's heiress chooses a quiet life away from publicity.
heiress.zh: 小說中的女繼承人選擇遠離媒體過平靜生活。

herald.en: Many people saw the discovery as a herald of further change.
herald.zh: 許多人把這項發現視為更多改變的先兆。

hesitantly.en: She hesitantly raised her hand before asking the question.
hesitantly.zh: 她猶豫地舉起手，然後提出問題。

hinder.en: Poor communication can hinder progress on a group project.
hinder.zh: 溝通不良可能妨礙小組專題的進度。

homeless.en: The community center offers temporary support to homeless residents.
homeless.zh: 社區中心為無家可歸的居民提供暫時協助。

horrifying.en: The documentary described a horrifying natural disaster without graphic images.
horrifying.zh: 紀錄片在沒有血腥畫面的情況下描述了一場可怕的天然災害。

ideological.en: The course compares ideological differences through historical documents.
ideological.zh: 這門課透過歷史文件比較不同的思想立場。

illogical.en: The conclusion seems illogical because it ignores important evidence.
illogical.zh: 這個結論因忽略重要證據而顯得不合邏輯。

impatient.en: The impatient audience began checking the time during the delay.
impatient.zh: 延誤期間，不耐煩的觀眾開始查看時間。

impersonal.en: The automated reply felt impersonal despite being clear and polite.
impersonal.zh: 自動回覆雖然清楚有禮，卻顯得缺乏人情味。

impolite.en: It is impolite to interrupt someone who is still speaking.
impolite.zh: 打斷仍在說話的人是不禮貌的。
